name: shelf
description: A touch-first, self-hosted music controller for browsing albums as CDs and cassettes, with Jellyfin, Spotify and WiiM playback.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @shelf/server" "npm run dev -w @shelf/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @shelf/server && npm run build -w @shelf/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @shelf/server && npm run test -w @shelf/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @shelf/server && npm run typecheck -w @shelf/web
